primary_interest.quote: inference is really why I asked for the call.

use_case.quote: We have a batch document processing pipeline: course materials, student submissions, accreditation paperwork.

inference_framing.quote: I'd like to buy hosted inference by itself through an API. It would live in our own pipeline, nothing to do with voice.

inference_raised_by.quote: Elena, your note mentioned inference, so where do you want to start?

competitors_inference.quote: we've been talking to Baseten and Fireworks.

competitors_voice.quote: we're piloting Retell AI, and Samir's team has been using Vonage for regular phone lines.

decision_criteria.quote: One of them quoted about $0.37 per million tokens, and the number we got from you was about $0.69. So that's a big gap.

stated_reason.quote: Data residency. Our students and a big chunk of our records are in Australia, so the data has to stay in-region. And we'd need a DPA signed. That's pretty much a gate for us.
